cases.sentence: О, если бы голова моя была водным потоком, и глаза мои фонтаном слез, чтобы оплакивать мне днем и ночью сраженных из моего ___!
cases.translation: Oh, if only my head were a stream of water, and my eyes a fountain of tears, so I could weep day and night for the slain of my people!
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of, from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Как лук напрягают язык для лжи, неистиной побеждают в ___.
cases.translation: As a bow is drawn tight, they draw their tongue, their falsehood conquers in the land.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governing a location uses the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Beware of your friends, do not trust friends.
cases.explain: The verb остерегаться (to beware of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они приучили свой язык лгать и грешат до ___.
cases.translation: They have trained their tongue to lie, and they weary themselves committing iniquity.
cases.explain: The preposition до (until, to) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Ты живешь среди коварного ___, и из-за своего коварства они отказываются знать меня.
cases.translation: You dwell in the midst of a deceitful people, and because of their deceit they refuse to know me.
cases.explain: The preposition среди (among) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: С ближним они говорят подружески, а в ___ готовят западню.
cases.translation: They speak peaceably with their neighbor, but in their heart they set a trap.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governing a location uses the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Их ___ — гибельная стрела, он источает коварство.
cases.translation: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaks deceit.
cases.explain: The tongue is the grammatical subject of the sentence, requiring the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я переплавлю и испытаю их. А как еще мне поступить с моим грешным ___?
cases.translation: I will refine them and test them. How else should I deal with my sinful people?
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

reading.question: How does the text describe the people?
options: They are all adulterers and treacherous
reading.correct: They are all adulterers and treacherous
reading.explain: The text states 'Все они блудники, сборище вероломных!' — All of them are adulterers, a gathering of treacherous men.

reading.ru: Друг лжет другу, никто правды в лицо не говорит.
reading.question: What does the text say about truth among friends?
options: Friends tell each other the truth
No one speaks the truth to another's face
reading.correct: No one speaks the truth to another's face
reading.explain: The passage reads 'Друг лжет другу, никто правды в лицо не говорит' — A friend deceives a friend; no one speaks the truth to another's face.

reading.question: What does God say He will do to His people?
options: He will punish them with the sword
He will melt them and test them
reading.correct: He will melt them and test them
reading.explain: The text says 'Я переплавлю и испытаю их' — I will melt them and test them.

reading.ru: Я сделаю Иерусалим грудой развалин, логовом шакалов.
reading.question: What will God make of Jerusalem?
options: A heap of ruins and a den of jackals
reading.correct: A heap of ruins and a den of jackals
reading.explain: The verse says 'Я сделаю Иерусалим грудой развалин, логовом шакалов' — I will make Jerusalem heaps of ruins, a dwelling place of jackals.

reading.ru: Это за то, что они оставили Мой закон, который Я установил для них.
reading.question: Why does God say the land is destroyed?
options: Because they abandoned God's law that He established for them
reading.correct: Because they abandoned God's law that He established for them
reading.explain: The text reads 'Это за то, что они оставили Мой закон' — This is because they have forsaken My law which I set before them.

reading.ru: Напротив, они упорно следовали желаниям своего сердца, они шли за Баалами, как их научили отцы.
reading.question: What did the people choose to follow instead of God's law?
options: The stubbornness of their own heart and the Baals, as their fathers taught them
reading.correct: The stubbornness of their own heart and the Baals, as their fathers taught them
reading.explain: The passage states 'они упорно следовали желаниям своего сердца, они шли за Баалами' — they obstinately followed the desires of their own heart and went after the Baals.
